items.why: Meta launched its Muse Wonder AI models on Monday, with Zuckerberg calling them frontier-class. The announcement plus strong Muse app retention data drove the stock up about 4% intraday, per Reuters.
Profit-taking after a record run; AMD broke below $620 support as chip stocks suffered their worst week in a month. SOXX weakness and competition fears in memory chips are weighing on semis.

Oil rebounded after Zelenskyy said Russia struck Ukrainian energy sites despite Trump's declared energy ceasefire. A deadly Houthi strike on Riyadh's airport over the weekend added supply risk, per the WSJ.
Spot bitcoin ETFs saw $681M in outflows last week, their largest weekly withdrawal since June. Macro uncertainty and elevated Treasury yields are weighing on risk appetite, per CoinDesk.

market_note: Columbus Day: stocks open, bond markets closed.
summary: Markets are mixed on Columbus Day with bond markets closed: the Dow edges higher while the Nasdaq slips as oil rallies. Big bank earnings start tomorrow, with CPI due Wednesday.
